description: MLE-bench style (tiny Kaggle task, numpy only): a seeded synthetic 4-feature binary dataset where the label depends on the sign of the product of two features (XOR-like, with 3 percent label noise) and two features are pure noise. The stored baseline predicts the majority class (about 50 percent) and a purely linear model also stays near chance; a checks script trains and predicts through model.py, requires deterministic output and held-out accuracy of at least 0.90.
